candidate_name: Angola LNG expansion train (mini train / additional train at Soyo)
sponsor_or_proposer: Angola LNG Ltd (Chevron 36.4%, Sonangol 22.8%, Azule/Eni, TotalEnergies, BP)
current_state: Under study, not sanctioned. With New Gas Consortium (Quiluma & Maboqueiro) first gas achieved Nov 2025 and Sanha/NGC supply ramping, Azule CEO said Angola LNG 'is already thinking about this expansion, if it is a mini train or one additional train' (~3 mtpa mini-train concept). No FID, no design selected, no regulatory filing.
missing_threshold_elements: No concrete step taken (no FEED/FID, no EPC, no capacity/design decision); expansion of the existing Angola LNG Terminal (T100000130245), so if it firms up it is a NEW UNIT on the existing record, not a new terminal.
watch_for: FEED award or FID on a second/mini train at Soyo; capacity and configuration announcement; Azule Energy / Angola LNG Ltd statements as NGC plateaus.
notes: dedup_index: manual_review vs Angola LNG Terminal (0.0 km) — same site, same consortium → expansion of existing record. Revival check on New Fortress Angola LNG Terminal (T100000130823, cancelled 2023): no post-2023 activity found (NFE IR terminal list has no Angola asset). Upstream-operator sweep: Azule/Eni NGC and Chevron associated-gas schemes all feed the existing Angola LNG plant; no standalone FLNG signal for Angola/Cabinda.
